marks.gloss_en: if at the future eulogy, when the evil inclination does not rule them, the Torah said men apart and women apart -- now, at rejoicing, when it rules them, all the more so
'and the land shall mourn, each family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their women apart' (Zech 12:12) -- at the future eulogy men and women are apart
בשלמא למאן דאמר על משיח בן יוסף שנהרג -- היינו דכתיב והביטו אלי את אשר דקרו וספדו עליו
אלא למאן דאמר על יצר הרע שנהרג -- האי הספידא בעי למעבד? שמחה בעי למעבד! אמאי בכו?
that is what is written: 'and they shall look to Me, whom they pierced, and mourn for him as one mourns an only son' (Zech 12:10)
כדדרש רבי יהודה -- the weeping at the yetzer's slaughter, as R' Yehuda expounded
כדדרש רבי יהודה -- the righteous and the wicked both weep when it is slaughtered (= p_yehuda_bochin)
R' Yehuda: in the future God brings the evil inclination and slaughters it before the righteous and before the wicked
כי הא דאביי -- a maaseh adduced for 'against Torah scholars most of all' (no maaseh support kind exists)
Abaye heard a man tell a woman 'let us rise early and go on the road'; he followed them three parasangs through the marsh; parting, they said 'the road was long and the company pleasant'
one said: [the eulogy is] for Mashiach ben Yosef who was killed
Rav Asi: the evil inclination at first is like a spider's thread and in the end like wagon ropes
to Mashiach ben David God says: ask of Me anything and I will give it to you
the evil inclination has seven names
Solomon called it 'enemy' -- 'if your enemy hungers, feed him bread... and the Lord will reward you' (Prov 25:21-22); read not 'reward you' but 'make him at peace with you'
Isaiah called it 'stumbling block' -- 'remove the stumbling block from the way of My people' (Isa 57:14)
'and I will drive it to a dry and desolate land' -- to a place where there are no people for it to incite
Abaye: had it been 'one who hates me' [himself], he could not have restrained himself
R' Yitzchak: a person's inclination overpowers him every day
